source: Which model nodes a car's weight-reduction choices (setup_options.json group "Weight reduction", rg/part_mass.h trim slots) take off the visible car (owner on PR #22, 2026-10-16). Per model (the .glb file's stem) a list of rules {slot, part, hide}: when the setup fits `part` in the part_choice option's `slot`, the model nodes in `hide` are hidden, in the drive (including the cockpit) and in the garage. `after_regeneration` rules name nodes that tools/cargen now produces but the committed .glb files do not have yet (regenerate with `python3 tools/cargen/build.py`, which needs the owner's LFS checkout); a node the loaded model lacks is ignored. A slot a car does not have at all (no passenger seat on a bench, no rear seats in a two-seater) is not in the catalog's `interior`, so the garage does not offer its option; it needs no entry here. `not_separate` says per slot why a model shows no change: the element is part of the body mesh, or the choice is a lighter part of the same shape. Core: rg/strip_visual.h; test tests/unit/test_strip_visual.cpp.

rules.note: the touchscreen and the steering wheel's volume/source buttons; the hands-free button stays; the screen's foot on the dash stays (body mesh)
nodes added by tools/cargen cars/pico.py (children of the doors)
node added by tools/cargen cars/pico.py (common.cabin_shell): the floor pad under the carpet and the rear bulkhead pad
nodes added by tools/cargen cars/pico.py: the console cup tray and the glovebox lid; the dash body, climate knobs and gear lever stay

not_separate.spare_wheel: the space-saver lies under the boot floor, where it is not visible; nothing to hide
not_separate.door_trim: until the model is regenerated the door cards are surfaces of the door nodes
not_separate.seat_passenger: until the model is regenerated the seats are surfaces of the body
not_separate.rear_seats: until the model is regenerated the rear bench is part of the body
not_separate.fasteners: a swap for a lighter part of the same shape: no visual change by design (bolt heads are not modelled)
not_separate.hood: a swap for a lighter part of the same shape: no visual change by design (the carbon weave is not modelled; a tint of the hood's paint surface is an open question)
not_separate.seat_driver: a swap for a lighter part of the same shape: no visual change by design (a bucket seat is not modelled separately)
